study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter prospective study
cohort: 450 women with placenta previa minor (< 20 mm from the internal cervical os) or placenta previa major (covering the os), aged ≥ 18 years, who underwent transabdominal and transvaginal ultrasound assessment at ≥ 26 + 0 weeks of gestation
finding: Emergency CD occurred in about 20% of women with placenta previa and PAS and 30% of those with placenta previa only and was associated with worse maternal outcome compared with elective intervention.
mod_finding: This study found that emergency cesarean delivery occurred in about 20% of women with placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum disorders and 30% of those with placenta previa only.
